title.narrative: UN- Action-Urgent and Lifesaving Support for Conflict-Related Sexual Violence Survivors in Sudan: Supporting Women-Led Shelters, Protection Services, and Livelihood Recovery

description.narrative: This joint project by UNDP, UNFPA, and UN Women, under the UN Action Network, delivers urgent, lifesaving assistance to survivors of conflict-related sexual violence (CRSV) in Sudan. Since April 2023, CRSV has surged amid mass displacement, economic collapse and the breakdown of protection services. Humanitarian access to the capital, Khartoum, remained impossible until March 2025, when the Sudanese Armed Forces re-established control over central areas. This prompted large-scale returns to unsafe neighbourhoods, exposing women and girls to renewed risks in the absence of essential services.The project addresses escalating needs, including rising CRSV cases, food insecurity and the collapse of support mechanisms in returnee-hosting areas. Targeting Khartoum, Al Jazirah, Gedaref and Red Sea States, it will reach 10,900 direct and 35,850 indirect beneficiaries with health, protection, and livelihood support.Interventions include survivor-centred multi-sectoral services and strengthened health and community capacities; support to women-led organizations to operate safe shelters and deliver quality care; livelihood recovery through vocational training, market linkages and cash-based assistance; and access to justice through legal counselling and representation. By reinforcing women-led civil society and inclusive service delivery, the project will contribute to fostering community cohesion, enable collaboration, and building trust in reestablished services.
